payload.summary: Four real Codex trials across two projects: two app-tool setup chats and two desktop UI submissions. Disk verified backlog persistence, fresh-chat plan recovery without duplicates and two acceptance refinements. Automatic UserPromptSubmit stayed unobserved; user trust remains pending. Controlled 30-pair benchmark: 79.17 ms baseline, 229.25 ms DIP blocking median, 150.88 ms paired added median; zero capture model calls. Same-ledger status size reduced from 338526 to 757 bytes. Stable configured verification: 65 cases, 63 passed, 2 POSIX skips; browser/deep-link and package checks passed.
